questions.stem: Explain how the Quickselect algorithm differs from Quicksort.
markingGuide: Quickselect focuses on finding the $k$th smallest element, not sorting the entire list.
Quickselect uses partitioning like Quicksort but only recurses into one partition.
Quickselect has an expected time complexity of $O(n)$, whereas Quicksort is $O(n \log n)$.
questions.explanation: Quickselect and Quicksort both use partitioning around a pivot. However, Quickselect only recurses into the partition containing the $k$th smallest element, aiming for $O(n)$ time complexity, while Quicksort sorts the entire list.
